Body anchor stays fixed, only arm tips/nozzle flex. No projectile drawn into sprite. Soft polished Pongdang Island game cartoon, clean warm colored contours, rounded readable forms, gentle painted shading, restrained highlights. Reference is PAINTING STYLE ONLY; do not copy the otter, fishing line, starfish or front-view pose.

card.prompt: Create ONE beautiful cozy Pongdang Island tower-defense game card illustration, opaque LANDSCAPE 4:3. STRICT TOP-DOWN game map scene: pale jade shallow-water tiled battlefield, THREE distinct small arched enemy entries along the TOP edge, a small ivory-and-teal stone castle at BOTTOM CENTER. A coral-lilac octopus cannon (reference1 identity only) on the left-middle and mint seahorse cannon (reference2 identity only) on right-middle protect the castle, their nozzles face upward. A few small hermit crabs and shrimp approach down three thin winding sandy lanes. A few short coral wall blocks gently redirect paths without completely blocking. Soft polished rounded hand-painted cartoon game rendering, clean coherent scale, premium warm ivory/jade/coral palette, subtle sunlight caustics, restrained details, no characters facing camera, no text, logos, letters, numbers, UI, grid labels, borders or watermarks. Reference1 and2 are sprite SHEETS for turret identity only: do NOT reproduce a sheet or repeat frames; draw a SINGLE coherent illustrative scene with one of each turret.
